summary: Wraps converter loop in try/except ValueError to return NotImplemented, letting reflected operators (__radd__) engage per numpy subclassing convention. Correct, minimal fix matching the issue and numpy docs.

issues.description: `except ValueError` is broad — could swallow a legitimate ValueError from _condition_arg (e.g. genuinely un-convertible value) and turn it into NotImplemented, surfacing later as a less informative TypeError instead of the original message. Scope is narrow in practice (unit incompatibility handled earlier via converters), so low risk, but a tighter catch or comment noting intent would be cleaner.
No inline comment explaining why ValueError maps to NotImplemented (deferring to reflected operators). Aids future maintainers but not merge-blocking.
